about: Every poll in Wikipedia's polling tables for the 2013-01-22 election, from the day after the previous election (2009-02-10) to the day before the vote, newest first: 102 polls by 27 pollsters (0 by Shlomo Filber's firms). The outgoing Knesset was dissolved on 2012-10-15 (62 polls since). Same schema as the 28-day files in data/ (2013 has no 28-day file; its lists, blocs and agreements are judgments written out in the build script); parties that merged, split or withdrew during the campaign have their own ids, listed in otherLists (`into` names the final list they merged into). Built by scripts/forecast/backtest/build-data-full.py; memo docs/research/polls-method/round2/D1-data-full.md.
blocNote: 2013 judgments (made for this file; no calibration.json entry): the Netanyahu bloc is the right-religious bloc that won 61 seats and recommended Netanyahu: Likud Yisrael Beiteinu, Jewish Home, Shas, UTJ, plus Otzma LeYisrael (far right, failed). Yesh Atid (centrist, first run, uncommitted, joined the government after the vote) is 'mid' as Kulanu 2015 is; Am Shalem (moderate Haredi split from Shas, failed) is 'mid'. Labor, Hatnuah, Meretz and Kadima are 'opp'; Ra'am-Ta'al, Hadash and Balad 'arab'. Counting Yesh Atid as 'opp' instead gives the usual 61-59 split; the 'net' total is the same either way.
